title: Anime Club Podcast
author: Kristofer Read and Phoebe Munson
description: Ever wondered if an anime series is worth sinking your time into? With so many anime out there to choose from, it can be daunting knowing where to start. Each week Kris and Phoebe watch the first 3 episodes of a different anime series and discuss what they like, and whether it would be worth continuing. (Plus they just wanted an excuse to watch more anime, the nerds)
